name: tetrahedron
description: A tetrahedron with three visible triangular faces.
useCase: Select a tetrahedron primitive in a 3D editor.
misuse: Label the solid when users need to distinguish it from other geometric primitives.

16.reason: The complete visible face edges meet at shared vertices inside the square drawing frame.

24.reason: Symmetric outlines and separated face interiors preserve the solid geometry at toolbar sizes.
